text:
Nina Park: quick post-all-hands thread for the runtime Q&A — collecting clarifying Qs and action items from the roadmap segment. please keep replies short; i'll collate. :wave:
Omar Vega: thanks Nina. for the batching goals, what's the new p95 target on A100-class for 8k context after the kernel changes?
Nina Park: target p95 = 90ms for single-request gen with continuous batching + prefix caching enabled (typical workload mix).
Priya Rao: is that using the adaptive batch window or fixed 5ms? curious about variance under bursty traffic.
Nina Park: adaptive window with max_delay_ms=7 by default. we also cap batch size at 64 to avoid head-of-line latency.
Devon Li: for cache behavior — what's our plan for cache warmup during canaries? last time cold starts spiked token costs.
Nina Park: plan is twofold: 1) pre-warm using a warmup job that replays top prefixes, 2) persist a short-lived LRU of hot keys to local NVMe. we'll run warmup for first 10 minutes of each canary.
Samir Khan: can we get the warmup job command snippet?
Nina Park: sure, example below:
```
# warmup job example
./redwood-warmup --input hot_prefixes.json --concurrency 6 --rate-limit 2000
```
Omar Vega: kernel question: how does the new fused_attn_v3 affect token throughput for decoder-only models? any regressions for short contexts?
Nina Park: fused_attn_v3 improves long-context throughput by ~18% on stride-heavy workloads, neutral for <512 context. small memory bump ~4% at 16k. it's behind feature flag for the canary.
Priya Rao: we need explicit numbers for Dedicated sizing. can someone own updating the docs?
Devon Li: i'll take the sizing doc PR. will add per-instance tables for memory and perf delta.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for fused_attn_v3 in eu-central-1 on 4 nodes at 09:12 UTC.
Samir Khan: autoscale follow-up: what metrics/triggers are we standardizing on? previous incidents happened because scale-up used cpu instead of queued_tokens.
Nina Park: standard triggers: queued_tokens > 40k for 45s -> scale-out; queued_tokens < 8k for 90s -> scale-in. also an anticipatory scaler uses short-term derivative of request_rate to pre-warm.
Omar Vega: logging/tracing: can we tag traces with kernel_flag and cache_status so we can filter regressions quickly?
Nina Park: yes — action: add kernel_flag and kv_cache_hit boolean to span tags. Zed (tracing) already okayed it.
Priya Rao: rollback strategy for kernel regressions? we need explicit steps in the runbook.
Nina Park: rollback steps: 1) flip feature flag (runtime) 2) revert canary nodes to previous image 3) drain new nodes and redeploy. runbook owner: Samir.
Devon Li: i'll add a small checklist SRE should watch during canary: p95/p99 latency delta, queued_tokens, GPU memory OOMs, error-rate, kv miss-rate.
InfraBot: alert-bot: Note — previous canary had kv miss-rate spike to +18% during first 5m. keep an eye.
Samir Khan: can we schedule a 30-min triage tomorrow 11:00 PT? short agenda: canary health, warmup effectiveness, sizing doc PR review.
Nina Park: scheduled. pre-reads posted in the runtime repo link (I'll DM). thanks all. if you have detailed follow-ups open issues in runtime/ops and tag @nina. :thumbsup:
